taskText: Explore eian-paper-ui-broll — Turn a simple conversation into a polished Paper UI B-roll video.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: What can I create with this skill?

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: Just provide a conversation, and the skill will turn it into a Paper UI-style B-roll video automatically.

messages.speaker: user
messages.text: Do I need to design the visuals or animation myself?

messages.speaker: assistant
messages.text: No. The skill handles the layout, message animation, typing effect, text timing, and final MP4 render for you.
